giveaway.default.announce: {{ username }} won the prize "{{ prize }}"!!! Congratulations!
giveaway.default.message_closed: {{ username }}, the draw has already started – new tickets come with the next giveaway.
giveaway.default.message_wait: {{ username }}, your next ticket is available in {{ wait }}.
giveaway.default.timer_message: Giveaway! Type {{ command }} to get a ticket every {{ interval }} minutes. Prizes: {{ prizes }}
giveaway.draw.done: All prizes have been given away.
giveaway.draw.empty: Nobody is left on the wheel.
giveaway.draw.title: Draw
giveaway.empty_text_hint: An empty field means: quiet – the bot says nothing at that point.
giveaway.end_note: All tickets are deleted, the wheel disappears and the switch in the menu turns off. The list of winners stays.
giveaway.entries_empty: Nobody has a ticket yet. Viewers get one in chat with %{command}.
giveaway.error.all_drawn: All prizes have already been given away.
giveaway.error.bad_command: The command may only contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphen and underscore.
giveaway.error.command_taken: %{command} already exists as a chat command – it would answer before the giveaway.
giveaway.error.no_prizes: No prize has been added yet.
giveaway.error.nobody_left: Nobody is left on the wheel.
giveaway.error.not_drawing: The draw has not started yet.
giveaway.error.prizes_locked: The prizes cannot be changed during the draw.
giveaway.field.announce: Announcement in chat when the wheel stops
giveaway.field.message_closed: Reply when the draw has already started
giveaway.field.message_ok: Reply when a ticket was given
giveaway.field.message_wait: Reply when the interval is not over yet
giveaway.field.multiple_wins: Winners may win more than once
giveaway.field.multiple_wins_hint: The winning ticket is always removed. With the switch off, the winner leaves the wheel entirely.
giveaway.field.timer_lines: At least … chat lines in between
giveaway.lead: Viewers collect tickets in chat, the wheel of fortune in the overlay draws the winners – prize by prize, from bottom to top.
giveaway.name: Giveaway
giveaway.off_hint: The giveaway is off: the command hands out no tickets and the advertising stays quiet. Switch it on with the switch in the menu.
giveaway.perm.edit: may set up prizes, command, texts and advertising.
giveaway.perm.manage: may draw winners and end the giveaway.
giveaway.perm.toggle: may switch the giveaway on and off.
giveaway.prizes_hint: Drawn from bottom to top – the top prize comes last.
giveaway.timer_hint: Runs through the timer plugin: only while live, only while tickets can be collected, and only after enough chat lines.
giveaway.timer_needs_plugin: Advertising in chat needs the “Chat - Timer” plugin. The giveaway works without it – just without reminders in chat.
giveaway.toggle_hint: Switch the giveaway on or off
giveaway.why.off: Switch it on first – with the switch in the menu.
